cache_tasks.description: Stores the last loaded tasks in plain text on this computer so the panel can paint before the first request.
cache_tasks.label: Keep tasks locally

confirm_delete.description: Ask for confirmation in the panel before a task is deleted.
confirm_delete.label: Confirm before deleting

default_labels.description: Shown as a capture hint. Todoist parses projects and labels from the task text.
default_labels.label: Default labels

default_priority.description: Shown as a capture hint. Todoist parses p1-p4 from the task text.
default_priority.label: Default priority

default_project.description: Shown as a capture hint. Todoist parses #project from the task text.
default_project.label: Default project

max_retries.description: How many times a failed read is retried. Creating a task is never retried.
max_retries.label: Automatic retries

token_file.description: Path to a file holding your Todoist API token. Either the bare token or a line like TODOIST_API_TOKEN = xxx works.
